data.one_liner: Enables easy creation of custom parsers for widgets and actions in server-driven UI implementations.
data.what_it_does: Provides abstract classes like StacParser and StacActionParser to help developers build custom widget and action parsers for server-driven UI. It allows extending Stac functionality to support custom widgets, user inputs, and server actions.
use_when: You are implementing server-driven UI using Stac and need custom widgets.
You need to parse custom action types such as sending messages to a remote server.
avoid_when: You are building a standard Flutter application without server-driven UI requirements.
You do not use the Stac framework in your architecture.
strengths: Simplifies creating custom parsers for widgets and actions.
weaknesses: Strictly tied to the Stac ecosystem and has limited utility outside of it.
Documentation for advanced edge cases is minimal.
data.setup_notes: Add the package to pubspec.yaml and import stac_framework.dart.
